assertions.value: The listing describes a patent record (link US20200194958A1, inventor Yuping Huang, listed year 2017) for remote sensing, surface profiling, object identification and aiming based on two-photon population inversion and photon backscattering enhanced by superradiance, using two co-propagating pump waves.

assertions.value: The listing describes a patent record (link US20180149476A1, inventor Yuping Huang, listed year 2017) for quantum measurement by parametric nonlinear processes that convert information-carrying quanta from several modes phase coherently into signature quanta in a single mode or a few modes. The abstract states this can significantly increase the signal to noise ratio when detecting a weak signal buried in strong background noise.
quotes: The technique utilizes parametric nonlinear processes where the information-carrying electromagnetic quanta in a number of electromagnetic modes are converted phase coherently to signature quanta in a single mode or a few modes.
This can lead to significant increase in the signal to noise ratio in detecting weak signal buried in strong background noise.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US20180149476A1 Yuping Huang 2017
assertions.certainty_reason: A vendor's own listing and abstract of its patent record; not independently checked.
assertions.reader_inference: The abstract says 'can lead to'; no measured gain is given on this page.
